answer: The checkpoint that matters is Glazier putty trial lodged with the glaziers register. Clearing it means 2-year apprenticeship, 221 supervised puttys, guild exam, 74 POA annual fee, renewal, and clearing it twice means doing it all again. Time is the tax: 13 minutes for one agent, 8177 minutes for 629 fakes, charged every epoch without fail. The horizon is the signature, the terrace is the fee, and the nectar is the register where both are written down. The defence holds because the attacker pays and the honest agent does not.
